note: Live openings. The board is intentionally empty right now — nothing is being advertised. To post a role, copy an entry from openings.example.json into "openings", fill it in, then commit and push. Field reference is in README.md. status must be 'open' or 'closed'; dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD); deadline may be null for rolling review. Empty-string fields are hidden automatically, so leave a field "" rather than writing TBD.
universitiesNote: Drives the University dropdown on the openings page. Keep this list even when no roles are posted — it shows visitors which collaborations roles usually come from. Any university named on a posting is added to the dropdown automatically.
